tool_schemas.name: get-crypto-price
tool_schemas.description: Resolves the provided cryptocurrency symbol to a known asset and returns the latest ingested price snapshot along with 24h statistics for that asset. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the symbol is missing/empty, and NOT_FOUND if the symbol cannot be resolved to a supported asset. May raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded and SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE if no current snapshot is available due to ingestion outage.

tool_schemas.name: get-market-analysis
tool_schemas.description: Resolves the provided cryptocurrency symbol and returns the latest exchange-level market metrics for that asset, including top exchanges and volume distribution; results are returned as a single analysis payload (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the symbol is missing/empty, and NOT_FOUND if the symbol does not map to a supported asset or no market metrics exist for it yet. May raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded and SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE when upstream ingestion has not produced a recent metrics set.

tool_schemas.name: get-historical-analysis
tool_schemas.description: Resolves the provided cryptocurrency symbol and returns an OHLCV candle series for the requested interval over the last N days, suitable for historical price analysis; the response contains the full candle list for the requested window (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if symbol is missing/empty, interval is not one of m5/m15/m30/h1/h2/h6/h12/d1, or days is outside 1–30, and NOT_FOUND if the symbol cannot be resolved or there are no candles for the requested range/interval. May raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded and SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE when candle data is temporarily unavailable.

interval.description: Time interval (m5, m15, m30, h1, h2, h6, h12, d1)

tool_schemas.name: list-crypto-assets
tool_schemas.description: Lists cryptocurrency reference assets with optional filtering by symbol/name/status and cursor pagination. Returns only assets visible to the caller; may refuse with RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

q.description: Free-text search over symbol and name (case-insensitive).

limit.description: Maximum number of assets to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tool_schemas.name: get-crypto-asset
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single cryptocurrency asset by id. Returns NOT_FOUND if the asset does not exist or is not visible to the caller; may refuse with RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: upsert-crypto-asset
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new cryptocurrency asset or updates an existing one. Enforces unique symbol/coingecko_id constraints and only allows status changes that follow declared lifecycle transitions; refuses with CONFLICT on invalid transitions or uniqueness violations that cannot be resolved.

id.description: If provided, updates the existing asset with this id; otherwise creates a new asset.

is_active.description: Whether the asset is enabled for resolution/queries.

status.description: Lifecycle status; transitions are validated server-side.

merged_into_asset_id.description: When setting status to 'merged', the surviving asset id this asset was merged into.

tool_schemas.name: upsert-price-snapshot
tool_schemas.description: Ingests (creates or updates) a price snapshot for an asset using its natural key. On conflict, upserts and only advances ingestion_status via allowed lifecycle transitions (partial→complete/error). Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for unknown assets/external ids or invalid lifecycle transitions.

asset_id.description: Resolved crypto_assets.id the snapshot belongs to.

observed_at.description: Timestamp the market data was observed.

market_cap.description: Market capitalization in the quote currency.

volume_24h.description: 24h traded volume in the quote currency.

ingestion_status.description: Ingestion lifecycle status; transitions validated server-side.

tool_schemas.name: upsert-exchange-market-metric
tool_schemas.description: Ingests (creates or updates) an exchange-level market metric row using its natural key. On conflict, upserts and only advances status via allowed lifecycle transitions (valid→superseded/error). Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for unknown asset/exchange or invalid transitions.

volume_24h.description: 24h volume on the exchange for this asset/currency.

liquidity_score.description: Liquidity score as provided by the source.
